title: Godot import contract
description: <project>/import_rules.json, and a kit's <kit>/import_overrides.json (same keys, all optional; the kit's value wins key by key). Read by pipelines/godot_import.py.

scale.description: Godot import root scale applied to the GLB; the stage checks the imported mesh's longest side is this multiple of the GLB's.

scale_tolerance.description: Allowed relative error on the scale check (0.05 = 5%).

collision.description: Collision the stage builds on the landed scene: none, box (BoxShape3D around all meshes), convex (ConvexPolygonShape3D per mesh), trimesh (ConcavePolygonShape3D per mesh).

material_slots.description: Expected total surface (material slot) count across the asset's meshes; null skips the check.

animation_names.description: Clips that must be present in the imported AnimationPlayer.

land_in.description: res:// folder the GLB is copied into (and its wrapper .tscn saved beside it).
